name: Merchant Unions
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.effect: Pick up to three enemy models within 18", which take 2 hits with AP(1) each. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Strider Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule. This effect lasts until the first wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane in melee.

specialRules.name: Union Assault
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and against units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Grounded Precision
specialRules.description: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Grounded Reinforcement Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Reinforcement. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule. This effect lasts until the first wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Relentless Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 4 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Strider
specialRules.description: May ignore the effects of difficult terrain when moving, and only needs 2+ to pass jumping rolls.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Grounded Reinforcement
specialRules.description: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Reinforcement
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken or fully destroyed, you may remove it from the table as destroyed and place a new copy of it fully within 12" of any table edge at the beginning of the next round after Ambushers have been deployed. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
